status: Qualified planet-wide native cave surfaces with unchanged camera; supersedes the rejected automatic focus/select interaction

contract.toggle: Dim the existing surface and show every generated cave surface together, including the far hemisphere; toggle off restores normal lighting
contract.camera: Preserve camera, selection and ordinary globe orbit/pan/zoom on toggle and accepted input changes
removed: Cave-specific navigation state and key handling
contract.scale: Actual physical cave dimensions. Narrow fissures occupy few pixels when the kilometre-scale planet is framed; no exaggerated widths or substitute geometry.

diagnosis.data: All networks were already present in the accepted cave field. There was no single-network generation filter.
diagnosis.baseline: After removing focus, native quality 4 on the earlier single planet-spanning diagnostic domain produced zero native cave vertices for two generated networks at globe framing.
diagnosis.rejectedGlobalRefinement: Native quality 8192 on that same domain reached voxel.MaxRenderChunks and still failed the all-surface check.
nativeSource: Voxel/Private/Render/VoxelScreenSizeHelper.h: camera distance and chunk-size quality selection
Voxel/Private/Render/VoxelRenderSubsystem.cpp: one BoundsToGenerate box, depth measured from voxel-world origin
Voxel/Private/Render/VoxelRenderTree.cpp: native subdivision and voxel.MaxRenderChunks admission
diagnosis.correction: A static, tightly bounded and centered native VPP domain per network. All domains remain active together and are independent of camera direction. Native layers/stacks isolate each domain. The source stamp retains canonical body coordinates.

ownership.native: VPP owns shape/blend/AABB kernels, native voxel-domain meshing, subdivision/LOD, render components, material binding and publication. UE owns translucent depth-disabled diagnostic shading and visibility. Main terrain generation, presentation, quality, collision and sculpt/save remain native.
ownership.specialization: Select the existing operations for a stable network identity, clip actual cave air against natural rock and final air/backfill, compose the native diagnostic domains and pair them with accepted terrain publication.
notAdded: Recipe schema or diagnostic material UAssets
ownership.lifecycle: Retain native owners by stable network identity across accepted edits; create/retire domains only for changes to the generated network set. Hide only native mesh components, not source actors. No recipe/stamp input or mesh copying during navigation.
ownership.progress: Existing input-progress display reports native cave-network readiness; navigation does not trigger authoring progress.

assertions: Every generated network has native mesh vertices at the unchanged globe view.
Every projected network has native highlighted surface pixels. Pixel classification accounts for native tone mapping and subpixel terrain coverage.
Far-hemisphere network surfaces contribute actual visible pixels through the planet.
Toggling and accepted cave edits do not move or rotate the camera.
Native per-network fields and bounds exclude other networks and retain canonical clipping/backfill behavior.
90 navigation frames retain all native presenters, start no diagnostic input, copy no meshes and show no input progress.
An entrance edit retains all existing native domain owners.
100 progression presents all three generated networks with no camera change.
Cold native user asset roundtrips its own payload and is not replaced by a fixture.

limits: Frozen 2 km body recipe at 65 and 100; arbitrary advanced dimensions, larger scales and all possible profiles are not qualified by this run.
Native voxel sampling approximates the analytic cave field; maximum sampled field residual is recorded, not a global geometric error bound.
Current generator remains the bounded structural fissure family, not karst, lava tubes or large caverns.
No new cooked cave walking, mining, collision or sculpt-save qualification. No production streaming architecture is inferred from the editor domain layout.
